items.t: Rotary engine loses compression
items.job: Replace with rebuilt or remanufactured rotary engine
items.note: Owners report about $5,000-$8,500 total for a replacement engine. The old 8-year/100,000-mile extended coverage has expired.

items.t: Engine floods and won't start after a short run
items.job: De-flood engine and replace spark plugs
items.note: Owner-reported costs run from about $80 to $1,100, the high end including towing and ignition parts.

items.t: Ignition coil failure and misfires
items.job: Replace ignition coils (often with plugs and wires)
items.note: Owners report $100-$1,200 depending on how many coils, plugs and wires are replaced.

items.t: Clogged or failed catalytic converter
items.note: Fix the misfire first or the new converter can fail too.

items.t: Oil loss that damages the rotary engine
items.note: If low oil has already damaged the engine, see the compression-loss repair.

items.t: Weak starter and hot no-start
items.note: Basis: YourMechanic and RepairPal estimates (no parts-plus-labor source found). YourMechanic: $365 average ($225 parts, $140 labor), $596–$668 by model year. RepairPal: $380–$774 total. Test the battery first.

items.t: Hesitation from stuck intake shutter valve
items.job: Clean or free shutter valve, or replace solenoid/actuator

items.t: Coolant level warning and overheating
items.job: Replace thermostat, coolant level sensor or expansion tank cap
items.note: If the engine was overheated badly, much bigger repairs may follow.

items.t: Broken engine mounts
items.note: Owners report $300-$2,500 depending on how many mounts are replaced.

items.t: Fuel leak from fuel pump seals and pipe (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel pump seals and pipe, add heat insulator (recalls 16V-793, 17V-354)

items.t: Fuel leak at fuel pump mounting ring (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel pump mounting rings, add insulation pad (recall 21V-744)

items.t: Fuel pump failure
Takata driver air bag can rupture (recall)
Takata passenger air bag can rupture (recall)
items.job: Replace passenger air bag inflator (recalls 18V-402 and related)

items.t: Front lower ball joint can separate (recall)
Engine heat damage and fuel leak at high rpm (recall)
Transmission heat insulator can crack and fall off (recall)
items.job: Dealer recall repair of transmission heat insulator (recall 04V-075)

items.t: Electric power steering loss or jerky steering
items.note: Test the battery and alternator first; low voltage can switch off the assist.

items.t: Clutch pedal and hydraulic problems
items.job: Replace clutch kit (master cylinder or linkage repairs cost less)
items.note: A master cylinder alone is a much smaller job.

items.t: Alternator failure
items.note: Basis: YourMechanic estimate (no parts-plus-labor source found): $445 average ($305 parts, $140 labor), $755–$867 by model year; shop/dealer $909–$1,591.

items.t: Power window regulator or motor failure
items.note: Owners report about $56 for a motor gear repair to $250 for a regulator.
